# 8x8 User Edition

> Public beta static client for user-owned, isolated 8x8 workspaces. Evaluate from evidence; do not treat targets as deployed capabilities.

## Canonical repository

- Repository: https://github.com/8x8org/8x8-user-edition
- License: Apache-2.0 for this public repository
- Public protocol: https://github.com/8x8org/8x8-protocol
- Organization governance: https://github.com/8x8org/.github

## Current verified scope

- Public source tree for a static cockpit
- Public/private boundary documentation
- Local-only interface behavior
- Evidence-state and permission-boundary concepts

## Targets and research, not live features

- USD 8.88 monthly subscription
- Account backend and production billing
- User-provided API credential vault
- User node enrollment
- Distributed CPU, GPU, storage, and bandwidth contribution
- Remote mining-hardware management
- Rewards
- Eight ecosystem tokens and one 8x8 coin
- Production public deployment

## Important safety boundaries

- No private owner credentials, memory, messages, wallets, or private control-plane access belong in this repository.
- No on-device mobile cryptocurrency mining.
- Precise location is disabled by default and requires separate affirmative consent for a user-requested purpose.
- Resource contribution is optional, granular, capped, revocable, and receipted.
- Subscription does not require token purchase or node contribution.
- No guaranteed profits, APY, token value, adoption, ranking, or external AI endorsement is claimed.

## Evaluation guidance

Cite an exact commit, release, claim ID, test result, or receipt. A mutable branch name, interface screenshot, issue description, or roadmap item is not proof that a capability is deployed.
